memories.author: D04
memories.text:
- Gout
  - Status: Asymptomatic, serum uric acid 8.2 mg/dL (high), creatinine normal.
  - Plan: Start allopurinol 100 mg OD after food; lifestyle advice: limit purine-rich foods, increase water intake.
- Migraine
  - Status: Episodic, 4-5 days/month, currently on propranolol 40 mg OD for prevention.
  - Plan: Continue propranolol; add sumatriptan 50 mg SOS for acute attacks; advise migraine diary.
- Diet advice: Breakfast – low‑purine cereal, milk, fruit; Lunch – vegetable dal, rice, lean chicken; Dinner – light soup, salad, chapati.
- Weight 68 kg, waist 78 cm (below female cutoff 80 cm).
- Due: HbA1c 2025-07-05.

memories.author: D04
memories.text:
To: Rheumatology Dept, Vikram Hospital
Re: Ms XXXX, 53F, gout with recurrent hyperuricemia despite allopurinol 200 mg OD. Request advice on urate‑lowering therapy optimisation and possible pegloticase if needed. Enclosed recent labs.

memories.author: D04
memories.text: From Rheumatology: Patient advised to continue allopurinol 200 mg OD, target uric acid <6 mg/dL. If not achieved in 3 months, consider febuxostat 40 mg OD. Lifestyle reinforcement. No immediate need for pegloticase.
